selection_rule: retain every candidate whose normalized response exceeds the effective threshold on any full-grid or |fixed bias|>=1.48 V curve for any device; PARAMS7 are mandatory; no top-k cap

coverage_expansion.policy: symmetric widening of named parameters on every device of every polarity, applied for surrogate training coverage after direct NGSpice probes showed the required values lie outside the one-at-a-time box; it is not evidence that the wider values improve a card

adaptive_boundary_source.objective: mean over admitted curves of 75% mean four section RRMS + 25% worst section RRMS
adaptive_boundary_source.improvement_rule: objective delta < -1e-4 and no section worsens by >0.02
adaptive_boundary_source.recommendation_rule: at one probed multiplier, at least min_hits distinct devices improve in the same parameter/polarity/direction group and no probed device of that polarity regresses; the largest such multiplier is the supported expansion

adaptive_policy: Only repeated physical recommendations are expanded; each supported parameter/polarity/direction is applied to every device of that polarity, including devices that did not trigger the diagnosis.
